name: Natsume Kazuki
source:
A female teacher who teaches mathematics at the school attended by the protagonist. She is an academic elitist and treats students with poor grades more coldly.

She values discipline and always keeps her distance when interacting with students. The same applies to her colleagues, and she does not socialize with any of them outside of work, but she is fine with that.

Among the students, she has a reputation for being cold, but she is surprisingly popular.

[from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11746]official site[/url]]
